name: Old Blood
description: (Tag:bloodline)(Tag:magic)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:meta-resistance+)(Tag:talent)(Tag:vitality+)You carry Great One blood granting you greater vitality, energy, Esoteric resistance, and larger reserves that make Magic and Esoteric Arts easier to learn, understand, and train.
